title: High-Pass Filter - Band 7 (2600 MHz) for Millimeter-Wave Beamforming
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Stefan Richter

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a High-Pass Filter filter targeting Band 7 (2600 MHz) for Millimeter-Wave Beamforming. The filter is designed on AlN on Si substrate with a target center frequency of 2267.0 MHz and bandwidth of 384.3 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the Millimeter-Wave Beamforming module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: High-Pass Filter
- Frequency Band: Band 7 (2600 MHz)
- Application: Millimeter-Wave Beamforming
- Substrate: AlN on Si
- Package: Flip-Chip BGA
- Design Tool: CST Studio Suite 2024
- Design Center: Irvine Design Center

This specification applies to all variants of the High-Pass Filter design targeting Band 7 (2600 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       2267.0 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       384.3 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.6 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 10.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 48.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 39.0 dB
Q Factor:               12581
Temperature Coefficient:-18.0 ppm/°C
Die Size:               1.3 x 2.2 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   5
Electrode Material:     Pt/Al
Passivation:            Si3N4
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open CST Studio Suite 2024 and load the High-Pass Filter template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: AlN on Si with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 2267.0 MHz, BW 384.3 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.6 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (Flip-Chip BGA).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, AlN on Si).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Anritsu MS46122B ShockLine.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 6801 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.6 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 10.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 576 MHz offset >= 48.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 5 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 5.1 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +25 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 1000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 85%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-11-24
Devices Tested:         50
Insertion Loss (meas):  2.3 dB
Return Loss (meas):     12.4 dB
Rejection (meas):       51.4 dB
Isolation (meas):       44.3 dB
Q Factor (meas):        12581
Group Delay Variation:  5.9 ns
Power Handling:         +31 dBm
Die Yield:              94.9%

Result Classification:  FAIL
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The High-Pass Filter design demonstrated below-target performance for Band 7 (2600 MHz).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) ESD robustness exceeded specification by 2x margin.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Optimize resonator geometry to reduce insertion loss by ~0.3 dB.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Escalate to advanced materials team for alternative piezoelectric stack.
